// @version=5
indicator("Lucid 6 — Noise Area Momentum", overlay=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024), "Beat the Market", on NQ. Long and short.
// sigma(t) = average over the last 14 sessions of |price at time t / 09:30
// open - 1|. Upper band = max(open, prior close) x (1 + sigma), lower band =
// min(open, prior close) x (1 - sigma). Decisions only at :00 and :30 from
// 10:00 to 15:30 ET: long when the close is above the upper band, short when
// below the lower band. A long exits when the close is below max(upper band,
// VWAP), a short when above min(lower band, VWAP); an opposite signal
// reverses. Flat at 15:55. Use a 1-, 5- or 30-minute chart.
// Hard stop (added 2026-10-23): exit when price moves 0.50% against the entry
// (filled at the worse of the stop and the bar open). Same edge, worst trade
// about -125 pt instead of -220 pt.
//
// NQ 2018-2025, $1 cost per MNQ: about 1 trade a day, 38% winners, +6.1 pt
// per trade 2018-2021 and +9.2 pt 2022-2025 with the hard stop (+5.5 / +9.4
// without it).

lookback = input.int(14, "Sessions for the noise average")
useVol   = input.bool(true, "Volatility gate (skip if NQ 20d vol >= ceiling)")
volCeil  = input.float(0.30, "   vol ceiling")
volSym   = input.string("CME_MINI:NQ1!", "   vol gate symbol")
hardStop = input.float(0.50, "Hard stop (% from entry, 0 = off)") / 100.0
// Daily values: last COMPLETED session ([1] + lookahead_on), identical in history and
// real time (lookahead_off would use the forming daily bar live). Fixed 2026-10-23.

rvol20 = request.security(volSym, "D", (ta.stdev(close / close[1] - 1.0, 20) * math.sqrt(252))[1], lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
volOK = not useVol or na(rvol20) or rvol20 < volCeil

oMin = hour(time, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time, "America/New_York")
cMin = hour(time_close, "America/New_York") * 60 + minute(time_close, "America/New_York")
tfOK = timeframe.isintraday and timeframe.multiplier <= 30 and 30 % timeframe.multiplier == 0

var float dOpen = na
var float pClose = na
var float lastClose = na
var int ghost = 0      // direction of a stopped trade until its normal exit
var float pv = 0.0
var float vv = 0.0
if oMin == 570
    pClose := lastClose
    dOpen := open
    ghost := 0
    pv := 0.0
    vv := 0.0
inRth = cMin > 570 and cMin <= 960 and not na(dOpen)
if inRth
    pv += hlc3 * volume
    vv += volume
vw = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : na
if cMin == 960
    lastClose := close

var array<float> buf = array.new<float>(12 * lookback, na)
var array<int> cnt = array.new<int>(12, 0)
var float ub = na
var float lb = na
var int pos = 0
var float ent = na
var int entBar = na

// hard stop, checked on every bar after the entry bar
stopLvl = pos != 0 and hardStop > 0 ? ent * (1.0 - pos * hardStop) : na
if pos != 0 and hardStop > 0 and bar_index > entBar and inRth
    hit = pos == 1 ? low <= stopLvl : high >= stopLvl
    if hit
        px = pos == 1 ? math.min(stopLvl, open) : math.max(stopLvl, open)
        pnl = pos * (px - ent)
        label.new(bar_index, px, "NZ STOP " + str.tostring(pnl, "+#.##"), color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
        ghost := pos         // no new entry until the stopped trade's normal exit, as in the backtest
        pos := 0
        ent := na

isCheck = tfOK and inRth and cMin >= 600 and cMin <= 930 and cMin % 30 == 0 and barstate.isconfirmed
if isCheck
    idx = int((cMin - 600) / 30)
    n = array.get(cnt, idx)
    sigma = 0.0
    if n >= lookback
        s = 0.0
        for k = 0 to lookback - 1
            s += array.get(buf, idx * lookback + k)
        sigma := s / lookback
    array.set(buf, idx * lookback + n % lookback, math.abs(close / dOpen - 1.0))
    array.set(cnt, idx, n + 1)
    if n >= lookback and not na(pClose)
        ub := math.max(dOpen, pClose) * (1.0 + sigma)
        lb := math.min(dOpen, pClose) * (1.0 - sigma)
        sig = close > ub ? 1 : close < lb ? -1 : 0
        if pos != 0 or ghost != 0
            d = pos != 0 ? pos : ghost
            out = d == 1 ? close < math.max(ub, vw) : close > math.min(lb, vw)
            if out or (sig != 0 and sig != d)
                if pos != 0
                    pnl = pos * (close - ent)
                    label.new(bar_index, close, "NZ EXIT " + str.tostring(pnl, "+#.##"), color=pnl >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
                pos := 0
                ent := na
                ghost := 0
        if pos == 0 and ghost == 0 and sig != 0 and volOK
            pos := sig
            ent := close
            entBar := bar_index
            label.new(bar_index, close, sig == 1 ? "NZ LONG" : "NZ SHORT", color=sig == 1 ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=sig == 1 ? label.style_label_up : label.style_label_down, size=size.normal)

if pos != 0 and tfOK and cMin >= 955 and cMin <= 960 and barstate.isconfirmed
    pnl = pos * (close - ent)
    label.new(bar_index, close, "NZ EOD " + str.tostring(pnl, "+#.##"), color=pnl >= 0 ? color.green : color.red, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)
    pos := 0
    ent := na
if cMin >= 955
    ghost := 0

plot(inRth ? ub : na, "upper band", color=color.new(color.green, 30), style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(inRth ? lb : na, "lower band", color=color.new(color.red, 30), style=plot.style_stepline)
plot(inRth ? vw : na, "VWAP", color=color.new(color.aqua, 30))
plot(pos != 0 ? ent : na, "entry", color=color.yellow, style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
plot(pos != 0 and hardStop > 0 ? ent * (1.0 - pos * hardStop) : na, "hard stop", color=color.red, style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)
// Where the next :00/:30 check would close the position (it is a close-of-
// bar exit at the check, not a resting stop order).
exitLvl = pos == 1 ? math.max(ub, vw) : pos == -1 ? math.min(lb, vw) : na
plot(inRth ? exitLvl : na, "exit level", color=color.new(color.orange, 0), style=plot.style_linebr, linewidth=2)

var table tb = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 1, bgcolor=color.new(color.black, 30))
if barstate.islast
    msg = not tfOK ? "NOISE MOMENTUM: use a 1/5/30-minute chart" : not volOK ? "VOL TOO HIGH — no new trades" : pos == 1 ? "LONG from " + str.tostring(ent, format.mintick) : pos == -1 ? "SHORT from " + str.tostring(ent, format.mintick) : "flat — next check at :00/:30"
    table.cell(tb, 0, 0, msg, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=not tfOK or not volOK ? color.red : pos != 0 ? color.new(color.orange, 20) : color.new(color.gray, 50))
name: Lucid 6 — Noise Momentum
